name: Little Kingdom RTS
description:
Game Objective

In Little Kingdom RTS, you play as the ruler of a small kingdom. With limited resources, your task is to build a base, gather wood, stone, wheat, and gold, construct defenses, form an army, and survive enemy attacks. Your main goal is to conquer the entire map. Each level features a new map with unique resource placement, enemy kingdoms, secrets, and strategic opportunities. A survival mode is also available to test your tactics under constant enemy pressure.

Resource Gathering

To develop your kingdom, you must efficiently manage three key resources:

• Wood: Gathered by lumberjacks you assign to nearby trees. Used for construction.
• Stone: Mined by workers at quarries built near rocky terrain.
• Gold: Obtained by workers in gold mines, which must be built near gold ore.
• Wheat: Grown on farms and required to sustain your economy and army.

Proper worker distribution and building near natural zones are vital for sustainable development.

Construction

You can construct a wide variety of buildings, each serving an important function:

• Worker buildings: for lumberjacks, stonemasons, and wheat farmers.
• Military structures: barracks for knights, archers, cavalry, and mage towers.
• Defenses: archer towers, wooden palisades, and stone walls.

A well-planned base with complementary structures will help you survive even the harshest conditions.

Battles

Combat plays a major role in gameplay. You must defend and attack in real time, commanding your army against:

• Armies of rival kingdoms.
• Orcs, including warriors, archers, mages, and wolf riders.
• Wild animals and fantasy monsters.
• Undead, demons and other dark forces.

Each enemy requires a unique strategy, and every map offers distinct battle challenges.

Game Features

• Classic real-time strategy gameplay
• Charming pixel art inspired by retro games
• Varied maps with increasing difficulty
• Unique economy and building system
• Two modes: campaign and survival

From the Developers

Little Kingdom RTS is an indie game developed by a solo developer. The game is promoted by a single indie publisher. Your feedback and support mean the world to us – add the game to your wishlist and help us grow. The release is coming soon!
